featured_reviews.name: Sakshi Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am Kalpesh Pawar a student of St. Rocks High School.

My experience at St. Rocks High School has been wonderful and memorable. The teachers are supportive, friendly, and always motivate students to achieve their best. The school maintains a good balance between academics and extracurricular activities, which helps in overall personality development.

I have learned important values, built confidence, and created many unforgettable memories with my friends and teachers. I feel proud and grateful to be a part of this school, which has played a big role in shaping my future.

featured_reviews.name: Raahashree Thevar
featured_reviews.review_text:
"I am currently a student at St. Rock's High School, and my experience here has been wonderful. The teachers are incredibly supportive and have a unique way of explaining even the most difficult concepts so that every student in the class understands them clearly. They don't just teach from books; they make sure we truly grasp the logic behind what we learn.
Beyond academics, the school encourages us to participate in many social and extracurricular activities. These programs have helped us progress in our confidence and teamwork skills. It is an amazing school that focuses on both our studies and our overall growth as individuals."
"Every day at school feels like a new opportunity to grow, and I truly look forward to attending my classes because of the inspiring atmosphere here."

featured_reviews.name: Sanjay More
featured_reviews.review_text:
I Swayam More studying right now in St. Rocks school, feel proud to be a student at this school. The teachers are supportive, approachable, and always encourage us to do our best. They make learning interesting by connecting lessons to real-life examples, which helps me understand concepts more clearly.

The school environment is safe, friendly, and full of opportunities. From academics to sports and cultural activities, there’s always something to participate in. I especially enjoy the extracurricular programs, which allow me to explore my talents beyond the classroom.

The facilities, like the library, computer labs, and playgrounds, are well-maintained and accessible. What I appreciate most is how the school emphasizes discipline, respect, and teamwork, which makes us not only better students but also better individuals.

Overall, my school has given me confidence, knowledge, and unforgettable experiences. I’m grateful to be part of this community and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a place to learn and grow.

featured_reviews.name: Lalita Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: I am writing this review to express by deep appreciation for the management and faculty at st.rock's. Their dedication to student welfare and disciplined learning is visible in every aspect of the school. As a mother, my biggest priority was finding a school where my child would feel both, safe and inspired. After our experience at St. Rock's High School, I can confidently say we found exactly that. What stands out most is the personal attention the teachers provide. They don't just focus on the toppers; they truly care about the progress of every student. The school strikes a wonderful balance between academic rigor and co-curricular activities, ensuring that children develop confidence and life skills alongside their studies.

featured_reviews.name: Amruta Desai
featured_reviews.review_text: My both sons are studying since Nursery, now elder son is in 9th STD & other in 6th STD. In these 12 years journey, i had a wonderful experience. The teaching staff are very good at nurturing and developing the children’s academic skills as well as social interaction and productive play. The school is clean and well-maintained.  I really aprreciate the school for maintaining good discipline. Extra-curricular activities are also highly appreciated. I would always recommend this school to every parents

featured_reviews.name: deepak saini
featured_reviews.review_text: My child is in this school for past 7 years. My sisters did their schooling from here. School ambient is vibrant. They have medical room, Consultant is available for counselling of student. Teachers are approachable & helpful. Sports and other activities available for childrens so they grow well. Children are only allowed to leave premises after the guardian shows authority card provided from school.

featured_reviews.name: Tejashri shankar Thevar
featured_reviews.review_text: St.Rock's High School is the Best Educational Level School, I have seen in Gorai -1, My daughter Tejashri.S.Thevar is studying in this school from last 4 years .    Teacher's are very supportive, caring and encouraging all students to do better and boost their confidence.   Well equipped classrooms, computer Labs and good library are also there for all the grade students.  They also have extracurricular activities including the SPA class which is very useful for the students.  So as a parent ,I am giving my review about this school is ,this is best school for our kids bright future....Thank you ..S.Laxmi Thevar...

featured_reviews.name: divya kotak
featured_reviews.review_text: St. Rock's school has exceeded our expectations in terms of academic quality and faculty dedication. The curriculum is challenging yet engaging, and our son is constantly motivated to learn new things. The teachers are subject-matter experts who know how to make difficult concepts easy to understand. We also appreciate the school's communication with parents; we always feel involved in our child's progress. It’s a fantastic institution for building a strong foundation.

The chefs were incredibly skilled yet so friendly — they made everything simple and easy to understand. We prepared a Mushroom Risotto and a gourmet dessert, and honestly, the results were just like a professional chef’s creation.
What I loved most was that APCA doesn’t just teach recipes, it focuses on real techniques, hands-on learning, and working in a professional kitchen environment.
The academy is super well-organized, uses top-quality ingredients, and the vibe is full of passion and creativity. Highly recommend APCA to anyone who wants to turn their food passion into skill! 💯

featured_reviews.name: Valentina Quadros
featured_reviews.review_text: My three-month intensive course at Academy of Pastry & Culinary Arts was an incredibly enriching and hands-on learning experience. The program helped me strengthen my foundation in pastry and bakery while also introducing me to modern techniques and professional kitchen practices. The chefs and mentors were knowledgeable, supportive, and pushed us to constantly improve our precision, creativity, and discipline. It was a fast-paced yet rewarding journey that gave me both confidence and valuable industry exposure.

featured_reviews.name: Nirav Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience at APCA was truly amazing. I got the opportunity to learn a lot of new things, improve my skills, and gain valuable hands-on experience. The environment was very professional and supportive, and the guidance from the chefs and staff helped me grow both personally and professionally. It was a great learning journey, and I’m grateful for the experience.

featured_reviews.name: Rutuja Mahajan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I attended a really fun and interactive Sushi and Tiramisu workshop at APCA,Mumbai.
Hands on making, recipe book, and tasting session.
And great part------ It was absolutely free!!!
follow their instagram page and you will know next free workshop.

featured_reviews.name: Riya Amin
featured_reviews.review_text: I had an amazing experience either trove - this was my first time but definitely coming back again. Everything was perfect - right from the chef explaining the whole process in such a clear and concise manner to the whole facilitation process done by the trove team. Had such a fun time! Definitely recommend

featured_reviews.name: Aashvi Sinha
featured_reviews.review_text: Recently attended a sushi and tiramisu making workshop and the experience was amazing. The chefs were very friendly and encouraging. Ended up having the best tiramisu ive ever had! Would recommend this to everyone!!

featured_reviews.name: V D
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely delightful experience! Chef Anirudh and assistant chef Shreya, and Anika were fantastic instructors who made learning to bake breads a breeze. We had a blast making baguettes and pretzels, and their guidance was top-notch. The session was beginner-friendly, informative, and super helpful. They broke down complex techniques into easy-to-follow steps, and their patience and enthusiasm were contagious. We thoroughly enjoyed the hands-on experience and can't wait to try more recipes. Kudos to the team for an amazing session! 5/5 stars

featured_reviews.name: Selena Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience at this culinary school was incredibly rewarding. The instructors are knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely invested in student success. The hands-on training prepared me well for a professional kitchen, and I appreciated the emphasis on technique, sanitation, and time management.

Dear Witty Team,

featured_reviews.name: Kavita Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Witty International School always prioritizes the safety and well-being of its students and staff, providing a secure and nurturing environment that allows everyone to feel comfortable and focused on learning.
